[IALC.3.1] **protobuf-c.** libds defines one allocator that forwards to
the layer and passes it to every protobuf entry point:

Every `…__unpack(NULL, …)` becomes `…__unpack(&ds_pb_allocator, …)` and
every `…__free_unpacked(msg, NULL)` becomes
`…__free_unpacked(msg, &ds_pb_allocator)`. No protobuf call site in
hand-written libds may pass a `NULL` allocator ([IALC.9.2]). The shim's
struct dispatch is inherent to protobuf-c and occurs only on the
cold DSC-load path; it adds no hot-path cost.
